overview: Footage filmed between 2010 and 2026.  On April 26, 1986, Reactor No. 4 at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant near Pripyat, in Soviet Ukraine, exploded, resulting in a Level 7 nuclear disaster, one of the most catastrophic nuclear accidents in human history.  The fire burned for ten days. Carried by atmospheric currents, clouds of radioactive fallout spread across much of Europe, affecting nearly five million people. To this day, nearly 6,300 square kilometers across Russia, Ukraine, and Belarus remain uninhabitable exclusion zones.  The Chernobyl disaster placed enormous strain on the Soviet economy and severely undermined public confidence in its political system. It is widely regarded as one of the final blows that contributed to the collapse of the Soviet Union.
title: Radiation of the century  - Chernobyl Part I

data.overview: 影片拍摄于2010-2026年  1986年4月26日，前苏联乌克兰普里皮亚季城切尔诺贝利核电站4号反应堆发生爆炸事故，成为人类历史上最惨烈的七级核灾难。  大火燃烧了整整十天，放射性尘埃云在气流的推送下几乎横扫欧洲大陆，近500万人受到影响。至今俄罗斯、乌克兰、白俄罗斯仍有近6300平方公里无人区无法居住。  切尔诺贝利事故给苏联的经济和政治体制信誉带来了巨大的压力，被视为压垮苏联的最后一根稻草。
